evidence_level_definitions.LEVEL_0_NOT_TESTED: Code not executed in test environment.
evidence_level_definitions.LEVEL_1_IMPLEMENTED: Feature/module code written and syntactically valid.
evidence_level_definitions.LEVEL_2_UNIT_VERIFIED: Isolated unit tests passing in mock/in-memory environment.
evidence_level_definitions.LEVEL_3_INTEGRATION_VERIFIED: Local database / CLI end-to-end integration tests passing.
evidence_level_definitions.LEVEL_4_STAGING_ATTESTED: Verified against fixed Staging snapshot / SCN with rollback rehearsal.
evidence_level_definitions.LEVEL_5_PRODUCTION_ATTESTED: Verified against Production snapshot with immutable full-digest bundle.
